meta.method: Half-Kelly sizing. Forward-only from 2026-03-10. Every prediction with a Polymarket market gets a position recorded at time of writing — not retroactively. This is the test: if the edge is real, it shows up in this ledger.
meta.note: First 8-position portfolio (portfolio.html) was selection-biased — I noted market odds when edge was most visible. This ledger is different: systematic entry on every prediction with a Polymarket market, starting today.
